scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --locked -p rtf-parser --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rtf_parser.wasm --target web --out-dir packages/rtf-viewer/.wasm --out-name rtf_parser
scripts.fuzz:parser: cd fuzz && cargo +nightly fuzz run parse corpus/parse ../fixtures/synthetic ../fixtures/real
scripts.build:lib: pnpm build:wasm && node scripts/build.ts && tsc -p packages/rtf-viewer/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:rust && pnpm check:contract && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:types && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:package
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm test:rust
